name: Input Assist
description: Early-click rescue: keeps a jump press alive for a few ticks so it still counts.

enabled.name: Enable Input Assist
enabled.description: Master switch. Takes effect immediately, even mid-level.

stage.name: Rescue Stage
stage.description:
How long an early jump press stays alive. GD runs at <cg>240 ticks per second</c>, so 1 tick is about <cg>4.2 ms</c>.

If you let go before the press did anything, your release is held back until you land and jump, flip, or fire an orb, or until the window ends. If you reach an orb inside the window, the press is sent again so the orb fires.

Ship, UFO, wave and swing presses act instantly, so they are never held.

cycle-stage.name: Cycle Stage
cycle-stage.description: Steps through Off, Stage 1, 2, 3 and 4. A toast shows the new stage.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
practice-only.description: Only assist while practice mode is on. Normal attempts play exactly like vanilla.

show-indicator.name: Show Indicator
show-indicator.description: Shows the current stage in the top-left corner of a level, and each save under it for a moment.

log-saves.name: Log Saves
log-saves.description: Writes every save to Geode's log, e.g. <cy>Saved 3 ticks on tick 1042 (landing)</c>. To watch it live on Windows, turn on <cy>Show Platform Console</c> in Geode's own settings.

press-delay.name: Fixed Click Delay (ticks)
press-delay.description: Moves every jump press <cy>and</c> release this many ticks later, keeping hold lengths the same. Helps only if you click consistently early. <cy>0</c> turns it off.
